text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
while walking through the shopping district with Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, could that be—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Look over there, Trainer!
It's a circle soaring through the vast sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told to look up, I see
a large black kite soaring leisurely across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Kakerumaru is the villain.
And Chan-Meisho is the victim.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~, ham katsu!
It's fresh out of the fryer, so be careful, it's hot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Ham cutlet, ham cutlet—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And so, my poor ham cutlet was snatched away by the beak of that soaring evil circle. *Sniffle, weep*...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"No. Machan never forgets a face,
and she certainly never forgets a grudge over food."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I might lose sight of them while we're talking.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! Ultra Spy-mer-chan and
her assistant Trainer are on the case!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And now—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, how strange. I could have sworn
they headed towards this park, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After all, my opponent was flying through the sky.
Just as I was about to tell them to give up—"
(Squeee~ squeak squeak squeak)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A high-pitched scraping sound. It seems to be coming from somewhere up high, but—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh my, over in a place like that...

text_block_list.name: Black Kite Chicks
text_block_list.text: Kyuu, kyuii. Kyu-kyu-kyu.

text_block_list.name: Oozora Kakeru-maru
text_block_list.text: Pii~, hyorororo—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Aston Machan's gaze stood a large nest in a tall tree,
along with the black kite that had once snatched her ham cutlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So Kakerumaru was actually your mother all along.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that was the story behind
the ham cutlet theft incident...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Kakerumaru must have been desperate for the sake of his children, too. *sniff*"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hate the sin, not Kakerumaru—
Machan will never forget Kakerumaru, who taught her such an important lesson.
choice_data_list: Have you already forgotten your grudge over the ham cutlet?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "It wasn't forgotten, it simply changed. It wasn't taken away—it was passed along."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "If it fed those little ones, then both Chan-me and the snatched ham cutlet have fulfilled our purpose."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ultra Spy-Mar-chan will now return
to being your lovely mascot.
choice_data_list: I hope it grows up safe and sound.
I hope they grow up healthy and strong.
Should I pick up a ham cutlet as a replacement on my way home?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ultra Spy-Mar-chan will now return
to being your lovely mascot.
choice_data_list: I hope it grows up safe and sound.
I hope they grow up healthy and strong.
Should I pick up a ham cutlet as a replacement on my way home?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm, please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that mean... we'd be raising a bunch of Mini-Kakerumarus that will snatch our ham cutlets...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even just one Kakerumaru was a handful, but now that the Mini-sans are here too... This won't do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, it is time for Ultra Teacher Mar-chan to report for duty.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
For a while from now on, I shall come and teach
the rules to the soaring balls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it felt like Aston Machan could pull it off.
I decided to cling to that sliver of hope.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I did it. Ham cutlet on you.
You are very generous, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ham cutlets that don't cost any allowance
taste even better. How lucky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"How many should we get? Why not just have them
bring out as many as they've got—?"
choice_data_list: At least keep it in the single digits, please?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Kufufu. Just kidding. I'll make sure Lovely Chan-me doesn't turn into Chubby Chan-me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Alongside the opportunistic Aston Machan, I headed home eating freshly fried ham cutlets.
